decisions.reason: The multi-model formwork profile line has its own web page and sits at the core of the formwork offer, so after several years of investment the firm will keep defending it and treat weak results as market-cycle effects.
The automated distributor flow control embodies the announced automation strategy and in-house R&D, so management will justify continuing it even without strong visibility.

The shuttering magnet line is a cheap extension of the magnetic range, but withdrawing related magnetic strips earlier shows the firm prunes this area, so the risk of dropping it is moderate but still below keeping it.
Its dedicated web presence and fit within the integrated formwork system create visible commitment that makes dropping it hard to justify.

As a low-visibility component that overlaps with other magnetic parts it is the most likely candidate for pruning, yet it costs little to keep and complements the system, so the firm persists for now.
